Glossary

League has a lot of slang. Here are 92 terms you'll hear in games, streams and guides.

A

AA
Auto-attack: a basic attack. "AA reset" means an ability that lets you attack again sooner.
Ability Haste (AH)
Stat that lowers your ability cooldowns. More haste means you can cast spells more often.
AD
Attack Damage: the stat that makes basic attacks and physical abilities hit harder. "AD carry" (ADC) is another name for the bot lane marksman.
ADC
Attack Damage Carry: the bot lane role, usually a ranged marksman who deals steady damage with basic attacks. Also called "bot" or "marksman".
Aggro
Who a minion, monster or tower is attacking. Hitting an enemy champion near their minions or tower "draws aggro": those minions or that tower start attacking you.
All-in
Using everything you have (abilities, summoner spells, ultimate) to try to kill an enemy, instead of a short trade.
AoE
Area of effect: an ability that hits every enemy in an area.
AP
Ability Power: the stat most mages build. It makes spells deal more magic damage. Also used for champions who build it ("AP carry").
Armor
Reduces physical damage you take. Buy it against AD champions.
Armor penetration (Lethality)
Stats that ignore part of the target's armor. Lethality is flat armor penetration, best against squishy targets.
Assassin
A champion built to get in, kill one squishy target quickly, and get out. Examples: Zed, Talon.

B

B / Back
Recall to base (the default key is B). "Back" is also used to tell teammates to retreat.
Backdoor
Attacking enemy towers or the Nexus while the enemy team is busy somewhere else.
Bait
Pretending to be vulnerable so the enemy chases you into your team or a trap.
Baron
Baron Nashor, the biggest neutral monster in the top side river. Killing it gives your whole team a strong buff that makes nearby minions much stronger. See the Objectives: Dragons, Grubs, Herald and Baron guide.
Blue buff
The buff from the Blue Sentinel jungle camp. It gives ability haste and mana or energy regeneration.
Bot
The bottom lane, played by the ADC and support together. Also short for "bot lane".
Bounty
Extra gold a champion is worth after getting many kills or a big gold lead. Killing a fed enemy pays a bounty.
Bruiser
A champion that mixes damage and durability, usually in top lane or jungle. Examples: Darius, Sett.
Burst
Dealing a lot of damage very quickly, usually with a combo of abilities.

C

Cannon minion
The big minion that appears in some waves. It's worth more gold and experience than normal minions, so never miss it.
Carry
A player or champion who gets gold and kills and "carries" the team to victory with damage.
CC
Crowd control: anything that limits an enemy's movement or actions, like stuns, roots, slows, knock-ups, charms and silences.
Cheese
An unusual or surprising strategy, like an early invade or an off-meta pick.
Comp
Team composition: the five champions on a team and how they work together.
Control ward
A ward you buy that reveals and disables enemy wards near it. You can only have one placed at a time.
Cooldown (CD)
The time you have to wait before you can use an ability again. Track enemy cooldowns: when an important spell is down, it's a great time to fight.
Counter
A champion that's strong against another one. "Counter-pick" means picking after your opponent to choose a champion that beats theirs.
Crash (a wave)
Pushing your minion wave all the way into the enemy tower.
CS
Creep score: how many minions and monsters you've killed (with the last hit). The most reliable source of gold. See Last-Hitting 101.

D

Dive
Attacking an enemy who is under their own tower, taking tower damage to get the kill.
Dragon (Drake)
Neutral monsters in the bottom side river. Each one gives your team a permanent buff, and collecting enough gives a Dragon Soul.

E

Elder Dragon
A late-game dragon that gives a powerful buff to execute low-health enemies. It often decides the game.
Engage
Starting a fight, usually with a strong crowd control ability. Champions like Malphite and Leona are "engage" champions.
Execute
An effect that instantly kills (or deals extra damage to) low-health targets.

F

Farm
Killing minions and monsters for gold and experience.
Fed
A player who has many kills and lots of gold, making them very strong.
Feed / Feeding
Dying a lot, which gives the enemy team gold.
Flash
The most common summoner spell: a short instant teleport. Used to escape, dodge, or land a key ability. Its long cooldown makes it worth tracking.
Fog of war
The dark parts of the map that your team can't see. Wards and champions give vision through it.
Freeze
Keeping the minion wave in one spot near your own tower, so the enemy has to walk far forward (and risk getting ganked) to farm. See Wave Management: Push, Freeze and Crash.

G

Gank
When a player (usually the jungler) comes to another lane to help attack the enemy laner by surprise.
GG
"Good game", said at the end of a match. "GG" in the middle of a game is giving up. Don't.
Gold lead
How much more gold one team has than the other. A bigger lead usually means stronger items.

H

Hard engage
An ability that locks enemies in place to start a fight with no escape, like Malphite's ultimate.

I

Invade
Going into the enemy team's jungle to steal camps, place wards or fight.

J

Jungler
The player who farms the neutral monsters between the lanes and helps the lanes with ganks. See Jungle.

K

Kite
Attacking while moving away from an enemy so they can't reach you. Very important for marksmen.

L

Last hit
Landing the killing blow on a minion. Only last hits give gold.
Leash
Helping your jungler kill their first camp at the start of the game.
Level 2 spike
The moment you reach level 2 and get a second ability. In bot lane, it happens after the first wave plus three minions of the second wave.

M

Macro
Big-picture decisions: where to go on the map, which objectives to take, when to group. The opposite of micro.
Magic resist (MR)
Reduces magic damage you take. Buy it against AP champions.
Mana
The resource most champions spend to cast abilities. Running out of mana means you can't fight.
Meta
The champions, builds and strategies that are strongest and most popular in the current patch.
MIA / Missing
Your lane opponent has disappeared from view and might be roaming to another lane. Ping it so teammates are careful.
Micro
Mechanical skill: last-hitting, dodging, landing abilities, kiting. The opposite of macro.

N

Nexus
The big crystal in each base. Destroy the enemy Nexus to win the game.

O

Off-meta
A champion or build that's not popular right now.
OOM
Out of mana.

P

Peel
Protecting your carry from enemies who are attacking them, using crowd control or shields.
Poke
Damaging enemies from long range with abilities, without fully committing to a fight. Ziggs and Jayce are poke champions.
Power spike
A point where a champion suddenly gets much stronger, like reaching level 6 or finishing an item. See Power Spikes: Know When You're Strong.
Proxy farming
Farming minions behind the enemy's tower, between their towers. An advanced trick used by some top laners.
Push
Killing the enemy minions fast so your wave moves toward the enemy tower.

R

Recall
Channeling to teleport back to your base to heal and shop. Default key: B.
Red buff
The buff from the Red Brambleback camp. It makes your attacks burn and slow enemies, and gives health regeneration.
Roam
Leaving your lane to help another lane or the jungle.
Rotate
Moving to another part of the map as a group, for example after taking a tower.

S

Scaling
How strong a champion becomes later in the game. A "scaling" champion is weak early but very strong late.
Shove
Same as push: kill the wave quickly to send it to the enemy tower.
Skill shot
An ability you have to aim, which can miss. Lux's Light Binding and Ezreal's Mystic Shot are skill shots.
Smite
The summoner spell junglers take. It deals big damage to monsters and lets you buy a jungle pet.
Snowball
Turning a small lead into a bigger one, over and over, until you're unstoppable.
Soul
Dragon Soul: a powerful permanent buff a team gets for killing enough dragons. Its type depends on the map's elemental dragon.
Split push
Pushing a side lane alone while your team is elsewhere, forcing enemies to come and stop you.
Squishy
A champion with low health and defenses, like most mages and marksmen.
Summoner spells
Two extra spells every player picks before the game, like Flash, Ignite or Teleport.
Support
The role that protects and enables the team, plays bot lane with the ADC and places a lot of wards. See Support.
Sustain
Ways to heal or regain health and mana in lane, like life steal or healing abilities.

T

Tank
A durable champion who absorbs damage and starts fights. Examples: Malphite, Ornn.
Teleport (TP)
A summoner spell that lets you teleport to an allied structure, minion or ward. Common in top lane.
Tilt
Getting frustrated or angry, which makes you play worse. See The Mental Game: Tilt, Focus & Improving.
Trade
Exchanging damage with your lane opponent. A good trade means you deal more damage than you take. See Trading in Lane.
Trinket
The free item slot for a ward or a sweeper. Every champion has one.
True damage
Damage that ignores armor and magic resist.
Turret plating
Extra armor on outer towers early in the game. Breaking each plate gives gold, until the plating falls off.

U

Utility
Things a champion does besides damage, like shields, heals, crowd control and vision.

V

Vision score
A score for how much vision you placed, cleared and gave your team. Supports usually have the highest.

W

Wave
A group of minions that spawns at the same time. Managing waves is a key skill: see Wave Management: Push, Freeze and Crash.
Win condition
What your team needs to do to win, like "protect our ADC" or "split push with our top laner". See Win Conditions & Team Comps.

Z

Zone / Zoning
Standing or threatening in a way that keeps the enemy away from minions, an area or an objective.
